name: Rosazur
source:
Rosazur is a little visual novel which narrates how the dragons Rosalina and Azur decided to marry. However, your actions matter in a funny way: you have to try to make them break up.

Done for the TyranoBuilder Summer Game Jam 2015 with the theme "United by Fate".

[From [url=http://silvishinystar.itch.io/rosazur]itch.io[/url]]
